integrity: The proof uses the exact diffusion coefficients printed in Equations (2), (13), (15), and the Section 6 rewrite of Equation (2). The decisive calculation is the exact translation of the Itô diffusion and the positive short-time second-moment derivative at a deterministic positive equilibrium. A bundled exact-rational checker replays the algebra but is not used as an infinite-dimensional or asymptotic certificate.
scientific_limitations: The result distinguishes the printed abundance-proportional stochastic model from the equilibrium-centered auxiliary model; it does not analyze the long-time stationary law of the former.
No numerical parameter calibration is required or assessed.
The finding does not invalidate equilibrium-centered noise as a modeling choice when that different SDE is stated explicitly.
title: The mean-square stability theorem analyzes a different stochastic predator–prey model
